interface.name: liteos_shell_v1
interface.description: This system-service interface is advertised only to Shell connections delegated by the trusted session through wp_security_context_v1. It is not an ordinary application ABI. Window snapshots are asynchronous; commands are applied atomically by the compositor, in the same connection order as xdg and foreign-toplevel window requests. Only the latest effective batch is undoable. Manual operations supersede that window's batch membership. Destroying the last control object or disconnecting undoes the connection's batch. Version 2 adds arrangements of visible, resizable, non-fullscreen root windows. Maximized windows become normal; z-order is preserved. Size constraints remain binding.

event.name: state

description.summary: complete state of this connection's desktop transaction

event.description: Sent after binding and whenever the state changes. This is a snapshot, not an acknowledgement of any particular command. Toggle decisions remain server-owned.
